items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [project-aliases (⭐0)](https://github.com/dvigo/project-aliases) — Zsh plugin to automatically load and unload per-project aliases.
*   [zsh-hookie-projects (⭐0)](https://github.com/aemonge/zsh-hookie-projects) - Language-agnostic project detection with smart hooks, PowerLevel10k integration, and intelligent path shortening. Automatically detects 100+ project types, provides customizable on\_project/off\_project hooks, features a smart cd command that goes to project root, and includes a beautiful hookie\_dir segment that shortens paths like \~/projects/my-app → \~/p/my-app. Perfect for polyglot developers who want seamless project-aware shell behavior.

### ZSH Tools / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [complgen (⭐273)](https://github.com/adaszko/complgen) - Generates completion scripts for bash/fish/zsh from a man-page/EBNF-like grammar. The resulting standalone scripts require only the target shell to be present.
items.content_html:
Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • project-aliases (⭐0) — Zsh plugin to automatically load and unload per-project aliases.
  • zsh-hookie-projects (⭐0) - Language-agnostic project detection with smart hooks, PowerLevel10k integration, and intelligent path shortening. Automatically detects 100+ project types, provides customizable on_project/off_project hooks, features a smart cd command that goes to project root, and includes a beautiful hookie_dir segment that shortens paths like ~/projects/my-app → ~/p/my-app. Perfect for polyglot developers who want seamless project-aware shell behavior.

ZSH Tools / superconsole - Windows-only

  • complgen (⭐273) - Generates completion scripts for bash/fish/zsh from a man-page/EBNF-like grammar. The resulting standalone scripts require only the target shell to be present.
